title: RiemannBlueprint: 40-Module Lean 4.35 Formalization, 10-Theorem PrimeBinaryCompressionBooster, and 100-Digit Schur Trigonometry Suite (v3.4.0-rosetta)
description: Zero-Axiom Finite-Dimensional and Parameterized Bridge Certification in Lean 4 across 40 root modules (3,137 Lake jobs, zero sorry, strictly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) paired with the compiled PDF monographs (main.pdf, paper_k_dirichlet_anchored_plaque_criterion.pdf, paper_l_unified_arithmetic_lean4_master_review.pdf), the 10-theorem PrimeBinaryCompressionBooster.lean, and 100-digit flint.arb numerical verification up to N=1000 (4.45x {0,1} square-free booster, Weierstrass-Euclid pinch beta_min(N) - 1/2 = t_N^2/2 <= E_dir(N)/2 <= C_BBLR/(2 ln N)). notes: All 40 root modules and all 10 PrimeBinaryCompressionBooster theorems compile with zero sorry and strictly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
